hookSub: …but every one of them is true

items.title: Bananas Are Radioactive
facts: It would take tens of millions at once to harm you

items.title: Your DNA Is Insanely Long
facts: Each cell packs about 2 meters of DNA
It's coiled into a nucleus just ~6 µm wide
All of yours, unrolled, could reach Pluto and back, several times

items.title: A Day on Venus Outlasts Its Year
items.sub: The planet that spins the wrong way
facts: One orbit around the Sun takes only 225
It rotates backwards: the Sun rises in the west

items.title: Octopuses Have 3 Hearts
facts: Two pump blood to the gills, one to the body
Their blood is blue, thanks to copper-based hemocyanin
The main heart stops beating while they swim

items.title: Lightning Is Hotter Than the Sun
facts: A bolt can heat the air to ~30,000 °C
That's about 5× hotter than the Sun's surface
Earth gets struck around 45 times every second

outro.title: Which one blew your mind?
outro.cta: Follow for a new fact every day
